prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Charlotte after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Charlotte for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — to give you the best, most relevant firm recommendations I need a couple quick details. Please tell me:

- When did the accident happen? (This affects deadlines and urgency.)  
- How serious were your injuries (minor, moderate, major/hospitalized, permanent)?  
- Do you want a small local firm or are you okay with a larger regional/national plaintiff firm?  
- Any other preferences (Spanish-speaking attorney, trial-ready team, spouse/child involved, hit-and-run, uninsured motorist, commercial vehicle)?

If you prefer, I can give a short list right away of types of firms to contact and what to ask them. For each firm I recommend calling, I’ll explain why (experience with car-accident cases, trial record, contingency fee policy, local court experience, client reviews) and what to bring to the free consultation. Which do you prefer?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
